name: spring-ai-rag-retrieval-goldenset-v1
description: Small retrieval goldenset for Precision@K / MRR / nDCG. Docs are created by run-retrieval-goldenset.sh with stable titles; relevantDocIds resolved by title after create.

documents.title: GOLDENSET_DOC_SPRING_AI
documents.content: Spring AI is a Spring Framework project that provides abstractions for chat models, embedding models, and vector stores. It supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and Advisor chains for RAG pipelines.

documents.title: GOLDENSET_DOC_PGVECTOR
documents.content: pgvector is a PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search. HNSW indexes accelerate approximate nearest neighbor queries used by hybrid retrieval in RAG systems.

documents.title: GOLDENSET_DOC_RERANK
documents.content: Reranking improves RAG quality by reordering retrieved chunks. Heuristic rerank uses keyword and diversity scores; cross-encoder models such as bge-reranker provide higher precision.

documents.title: GOLDENSET_DOC_COLLECTION_ACL
documents.content: Collection isolation and API key ACLs restrict which knowledge bases a client may query. Allowed collection IDs are enforced on search and chat retrieval paths.

documents.title: GOLDENSET_DOC_UNRELATED
documents.content: Cooking recipes for pasta carbonara use eggs, pecorino cheese, guanciale, and black pepper. This document is intentionally unrelated to enterprise RAG topics.
